drain: Only lower Liquid solvent and selected aqueous/liquid solutes leave. Same-species Solid/Gas remain, independent of portion order; source plus receiver mass closes.
ethanol-water-distillation: Only Liquid water and Liquid/Aqueous ethanol finance the VLE cut; ice and gas remain. Receiver matches liquid-only positive control and total species inventory closes.
staged-extraction: Only reviewed Aqueous/Solid iodine stock finances the split. Gas/Liquid iodine remain; selected-pool outputs match control and total iodine closes.
stationary-domain: Nonfinite or negative owned stationary bulk amounts refuse before any CellChain mutation. Zero and positive stationary inventory allow transport.
mix-overflow: Finite bulk amounts with nonfinite mixing-energy endpoints refuse atomically. A moderate same-phase mixture conserves energy.
five-species-tiny-inert: At1300K/1bar carbonate/oxide/CO2/N2/Ar with Ca.1/C.2/O.5/N2e-20/Ar.2 returns CaO.1 CO2.2 N21e-20 Ar.2; no gas floor.
five-species-finite-control: At1100K/1bar Ca.1/C.2/O.5/N.2/Ar.1, full total-diluent CO2 mass action fixes the carbonate/oxide partition; independently assembled HP enthalpy reproduces TP.
